At this moment, Xiao Lu, who just steps into the court with the ball, interrupts and says, "The people who always play here are really bad at basketball." Xiao Hong turns her head to look at Xiao Lu and asks, "Let's form a team for a three-on-three match, do you want to join?" Xiao Lu hesitates for a moment and says, "No, I suddenly remember I have something else to do." After saying that, he turns around and leaves the court.
